name: premiere-project-file-assembly
displayName: Premiere Project File Assembly (go Diego go)
description: Writes Premiere project files from a conversation, a new version each time. Scan data or a media folder becomes bins 00-05, per-card stringouts, INTERVIEWS/BROLL, timecode sync; a small model inside (MiniLM) organizes B-roll by topic, every take of a line, and selects from notes. iPhone footage handled (creation date, slo-mo, vertical, HDR, approximate sync). Writes .prproj with our own prwrite library; xmeml as last resort. Verified by reparse; unopened in Premiere.
